_readme: Copy this file to filters.json and edit that. Empty lists hide nothing.
It is re-read whenever it changes, so there is no restart to do.
Any key starting with an underscore is ignored: use them for your notes.
Everything matches exactly except types, which match as substrings.
Every value is a quoted string in a list: ["LGA", "JFK"], never [LGA].
Check your edit with: python3 -m backend.filters

exclude._hex: ICAO 24-bit addresses, exactly as the receiver reports them
exclude._airlines: ICAO prefixes read off the callsign, eg SWA, FDX, JBU
exclude._registrations: tail numbers, eg N123AB. Needs a lookup, so an aircraft may appear briefly before it is hidden
exclude._types: substring match: CRJ hides CRJ 900, CRJ-900 and CRJ 900 LR NG alike
exclude._airports: IATA codes; hides a flight with that airport at either end

_altitude_ft: Feet. null means no limit. Aircraft on the ground read as 0, so a min of 1 drops them.
